builds.name: Tempest Trial Saviour
builds.desc:
Mist's default kit is very strong at supporting allies in Tempest Trials. Spur Def/Res 2 allows your allies to gain extra bulk when fighting or baiting. In combination with the either Spur Def 3 or Spur Res 3 Mist effectively grants + 7 to an an allies' Def or Res stat while also giving them +3 in the other defense stat.
Miracle is an outstanding skill in Tempest Trials, allowing Mist to survive fatal attacks and then recover hp through Renewal 3 or Live to Serve 3. This allows her to get another Miracle activation later in the trial.

builds.name: Helpful Sister Mist
builds.desc:
This is a character build based around Mist helping her brother Ike, it mainly buffs and debuffs attack so that Ike can make good use of Heavy Blade as well as generally weakening your enemies and strengthening your allies. The stats are +atk -def since she has superboon in attack which will increase the amount she can heal. In cliche terms, she has to do her best so that her brother can too!
For the weapon I chose Fear+ to decrease the enemy attack, making it easier for heavy blade to take effect and in general to weaken their offenses. I chose the refine that nullifies counterattack so you can debuff them without getting hit.
The assist will be either Recover+ for a consistent heal of 31, or Rehabilitate+ for the rare cases you need to fully heal someone right away.
For the special either Kindled-Fire Balm to increase all your allies' attack by 4, or the standard healing special Imbue.
For her A passive, Spd/Res 2 is good for rounding out her speed at 30 while boosting her res to 36, though more budget options are Res+3 or Spd+3.
Passive B is Wings of Mercy so that she can teleport to those in need of healing the most.
For her C passive Atk Ploy 3 will make use of her high res to debuff enemies or her natural Spur Def/Res 2 as it's pretty handy for boosting defenses.
For the Seal she'll have Drive Atk 2 to buff nearby allies. You could also have Atk Ploy 3 as the seal if you're using her natural C skill.

builds.name: Rival Domains Healer/Debuff
builds.desc: The core of this set is Wings of Mercy and Heavenly Light, allowing Mist to warp around the large Rival Domains map to heal the most heavily injured allies while periodically healing the entire group with her special. As a result, she will nearly always be next to an ally, so Spd/Def Bond grants her some amount of survivability if she needs to take a hit. Her high Res makes her a good candidate for ploy skills, and either her native Slow+ or Fear+ will be a decent debuff on the rare turn where no healing is required. The seal slot can used for Live to Serve to further improve her survivability over the course of the battle, for another Ploy skill, or possibly even a Smoke skill.
